description: This file provides functions for managing pinned filesystem paths via a Python helper script, including executing subprocesses, resolving Python interpreter paths, and performing directory operations within a root directory.

methods.name: isPinnedPathHelperSpawnError
methods.description: Checks if an error is related to spawning the pinned path helper process based on error properties.

methods.name: runPinnedPathHelper
methods.description: Executes the pinned path helper Python script with specified parameters to perform directory operations.
